#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-8;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) < EPS && fabs(y - other.y) < EPS;
    }
    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        double dx = x - other.x, dy = y - other.y;
        return sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() : center(), radius(0) {}
    Circle(const Point& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double d = center.distance(other.center);
        if (d < EPS) return {};
        double a = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double b = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                   center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                   center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        // Line: a*x + b*y + c = 0
        double h = sqrt(a*a + b*b);
        a /= h; b /= h; c /= h;
        // distance from center to line
        double dist = fabs(a * center.x + b * center.y + c);
        if (dist > radius + EPS) return {};
        // intersection of line and perpendicular through center
        double x0 = center.x - a * (a * center.x + b * center.y + c);
        double y0 = center.y - b * (a * center.x + b * center.y + c);
        if (fabs(dist - radius) < EPS) {
            return {Point(x0, y0)};
        }
        double shift = sqrt(radius * radius - dist * dist);
        return {Point(x0 + shift * b, y0 - shift * a),
                Point(x0 - shift * b, y0 + shift * a)};
    }
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    int sets;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0), sets(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        while (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];
            x = parent[x];
        }
        return x;
    }
    bool unite(int a, int b) {
        a = find(a); b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return false;
        if (rank[a] < rank[b]) swap(a, b);
        if (rank[a] == rank[b]) rank[a]++;
        parent[b] = a;
        sets--;
        return true;
    }
    int getSetCount() const { return sets; }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        circles[i] = Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            auto inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (!inter.empty()) {
                points.insert(points.end(), inter.begin(), inter.end());
            }
        }
    }
    int m = points.size();
    vector<bool> bad(m, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int nVertices = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) if (!bad[i]) nVertices++;
    int nEdges = 0;
    DSU dsu(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - circles[i].radius) < EPS) {
                onThis.push_back(j);
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            dsu.unite(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max(1, (int)onThis.size());
    }
    int nComponents = dsu.getSetCount();
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) if (bad[i]) nComponents--;
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << endl;
    return 0;
}
